candidate_decisions.reason: All nine nominated branches land in a bounded collective-to-individual reading. The 17:61 command/refusal and 17:63 following relation give the focus's call and imam a pericope-level trigger; the book, right hand, reading, non-wronging clause, and filament scale then join group orientation to personal inspection. The capacity and misplacement facets remain explicitly analogical or context-bound.

The exact 17:61, 17:63, 17:64, and 17:65 coordinates match the supplied context surfaces and return through the focus imam at 17:71:5:2. The guide is read as an enacted allegiance relation; context-root branch assignments remain attributed to the legacy-unbound trace.

The complete-recompense wording in 17:63 lands through the focus book, non-withholding clause, and filament measure. Every nominated branch has an exact carrier and focus return; the legacy-unbound source limits the claim to an attributed exact-settlement reading.

At 17:67 the supplied word index 8 is the root د ع و, matching the focus call branch; the context's loss and turning-away coordinates also match their supplied roots. The call direction reverses at 17:71 and returns through the focus call and imam. The result remains an attributed contextual inference.

The immediately preceding 17:70 sequence of honoring, carrying, and providing meets the focus's passive book-gift, right-hand receipt, and active reading. The personal-inspectability relation is retained as a qualified extension of accountable dignity, with the broad-framing alternative visible.

The immediate 17:72 continuation supplies exact blindness and path-loss occurrences and returns through the focus reading, imam, and book. The connection row is a nomination rather than a verdict, so the self-recognition reading is retained with its separate-ayah alternative and attributed status.

The focus imam and book meet supplied occurrences for revelation, attempted fabrication, stabilization, prophetic precedent, and denied transformation in 17:73-74 and 17:77. All seven nominated branches land as an attributed, multi-step orientation-and-record reading; the alternative scope of sunnah remains explicit.

The supplied 17:62 progeny and 17:70 sons-of-Adam coordinates match the HFT trace and return through the focus imam. The maternal and source branches have independent generational triggers; they are retained as an exploratory overlay without replacing the guide reading.

findings.title: Collective orientation and personal record
findings.claim: The pericope can present 17:71's summons as the point where a group's followed reference and each person's readable, right-hand record meet, with non-wronging measured down to a thread.
findings.mechanism: The commanded bow and Iblis's refusal in 17:61, followed by the explicit following relation in 17:63, give independent directions of allegiance that meet the focus's group-specific imam and divine summons. The passive gift, physical hand, written book, active reading, and filament measure then join collective sorting to individual inspection and exact justice.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold group affiliation and personal accountability in one scene. The book is received and read by its own recipient, while the closing measure carries fairness down to an almost imperceptible scale.
findings.containment: The focus still presents a people summoned by its imam and a recipient given and reading a book without being wronged. The community branch is a relation between the imam phrase and anas, not a translation of imam as community. The hand-capacity reading is analogical, and the misplacement facet is a contextual resonance from 17:61 rather than the focus verb's sole gloss.

epistemic.reason: The channel supports and focus branches are trusted, while the added capacity and concrete-misplacement relations are bounded contextual inferences.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ortak bağla birleşen topluluk veya tür
branch_activations.facet_statement: Ortak bir bağ veya aidiyet, insanları tek bir topluluk olarak birleştirir.
branch_activations.carrier: The imam phrase is possessed by the plural group, while anas explicitly names that group.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The preceding 17:63 clause names people who followed; the focus separately names every people-group.
branch_activations.activation: The group noun and plural possessor meet the community branch carried by the focus imam phrase, with prior followership supplying a shared-bond relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The summons gathers people as a community around a group-specific reference.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a community overlay carried by the phrase and its group relation; imam remains a guide, not a lexical substitute for umma.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Öne konulma ve başkalarınca izlenme, insan ve insan dışı kılavuzları birleştiren çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: Imam names the reference placed before a people and followed by them.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: In 17:63, the focus-surrounding sequence explicitly names those who followed Iblis.
branch_activations.activation: The followed relation in the pericope meets the focus guide term, making the summons disclose a practiced reference rather than only a group label.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Each group arrives in relation to a reference it has followed.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus still allows a person, book, path, or other guide; the context does not identify every imam as a human leader.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Ses ve söz, yöneltilen kişiyi ya da şeyi konuşana doğru çekmenin aracıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: Nad'u is the summons that gathers every people.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus specifies each people's imam, and 17:63 supplies the earlier relation of following.
branch_activations.activation: The group-specific guide and prior followership change the summons into a gathering by orientation, not an unindexed call.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The call gathers communities with their followed reference in view.
branch_activations.boundary: This preserves the ordinary act of summoning and does not determine the identity of any community's imam.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Cekirdek, bir somut islemde uygun zaman, yer veya kosulun bozulmasidir.
branch_activations.carrier: Yuzlamun carries the focus's assurance that recipients are not wronged.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: At 17:61, the command to prostrate is followed by Iblis's concrete refusal.
branch_activations.activation: That refusal supplies an act out of accord with an assigned relation; it meets the focus's non-wronging root and the record scene as an image of actions being correctly placed in judgment.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The closing assurance can also be heard as a guarantee that judgment does not misplace responsibility.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is a context-bound image of an ill-placed act, not a claim that 17:71 names Iblis's refusal as zulm or states its penalty.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: çekirdek yarığındaki ya da parmak arasında bükülen ince parça; pek az şey

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The adjacent non-wronging clause makes that tiny fiber a measure of how little can be withheld.
branch_activations.activation: The physical fineness of the carrier meets the categorical justice clause and gives it a minimum scale.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Justice reaches down to a fiber-sized measure.
branch_activations.boundary: The fiber is a measure in the expression, not a claim that a literal thread is placed in the book.

branch_activations.carrier: Yaqra'una is active reading or recitation.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The recipients do not only receive a book; they read it themselves.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the supplied reading/recitation image is used; teaching or mutual study is not asserted.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel işlem, harfleri yazıyla düzenleyip bir metin oluşturmak veya var olan metni kopyalamaktır.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The record is present as written material that can be examined.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İşlemin ürünü, yazılmış metin veya üzerinde bu metnin bulunduğu sayfa ya da kitaptır.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The verb yaqra'una names their active reading of it.
branch_activations.activation: The reading event activates kitab as an available written product, not only as an abstract ruling.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The judgment record can be read by the person to whom it belongs.
branch_activations.boundary: The written-product extension is retained with the branch's core writing facet; it does not replace the decree reading elsewhere in the pericope.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: uğur ve iyilik getirme, bunları umma

branch_activations.boundary: The physical hand remains present; this branch is an attributed association, not a literal gloss of hand.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: uğur ve iyilik getirme, bunları umma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Sağ tarafı bildiren kimi sözlerin mutluluk, iyi yazgı ve Tanrı'ya yakınlık için mecazlaşması.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The right-hand sign may carry the outcome's favorable valence as well as its physical location.
branch_activations.boundary: This extension survives with the branch's core facet; it does not mean that the hand itself is the source of good fortune.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsanın ya da başka bir varlığın sağ eli veya sağ taraftaki bedensel yanı.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: güç, savunma ve güçlü doğruluk dayanağı
branch_activations.facet_statement: Sağ el imgesiyle anlatılan güç, yetki ve etkili olabilme niteliği.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Right-hand receipt may also mark the recipient's capacity to engage the account.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch record excludes the physical hand as its direct sense; this is an analogy and does not say that the hand reads or adjudicates.

findings.title: Allegiance enacted before the summons
findings.claim: The imam by whom a people is summoned can disclose an allegiance it enacted through submission or refusal, following, shared commitments, and reliance on a trustee.
findings.mechanism: The focus imam is the carrier; the pericope supplies distinct enactments around it: prostration and refusal in 17:61, following in 17:63, participation in wealth and offspring in 17:64, and the sufficient trustee in 17:65. Their contact makes the guide a practiced allegiance relation whose effects are legible at the summons.
findings.reader_payoff: A group arrives with a history of alignment, refusal, and reliance visible around the reference it followed.
findings.containment: The focus retains its ordinary guide or leader sense. The trustee clause may name the Lord's sufficiency rather than any representative selected by a community; the HFT relation remains attributed and does not settle that alternative.

epistemic.reason: The exact pericope surfaces, word positions, and focus return are supplied, but context-root branch identities and the synthesized allegiance relation come from a legacy-unbound trace.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: A group's guide is seen alongside the alignment it practiced.
branch_activations.boundary: The trace does not identify every imam as human or prove that the trustee is a community's chosen representative.

branch_activations.boundary: The context branch label and facet remain attributed because no independent branch record is supplied.

findings.title: The record as exact settlement
findings.claim: The complete recompense announced in 17:63 meets the focus's personal book, non-withholding clause, and filament measure, allowing the book to read as an exact settlement.
findings.mechanism: The doubled jaza wording and mawfuran in 17:63 provide act-to-outcome correspondence and completeness. In 17:71, the book is read, no right is withheld, and fatil supplies the finest stated measure; these carriers and triggers make completeness concrete at the smallest scale.
findings.reader_payoff: The record becomes something whose fairness can be inspected down to what would ordinarily count as negligible.
findings.containment: The branch reading adds exactness to the focus's ordinary book and fairness claims. The live alternative is that mawfuran intensifies recompense without describing record precision.

epistemic.reason: The word positions and focus contacts match supplied surfaces, while the exact-settlement synthesis and context branches remain attributed to a legacy-unbound source.

branch_activations.carrier: At 17:63 word positions 8 and 9 repeat the recompense term.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus supplies each recipient's book and the assurance that no one is wronged.
branch_activations.activation: The repeated recompense phrase meets the personal record and fairness clause as an act-to-outcome relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The record can be read against a stated correspondence between action and recompense.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch label and facet remain attributed because no independent branch record is supplied.

branch_activations.carrier: At 17:63 word position 10 qualifies recompense as complete and abundant.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus presents a personal book and explicitly denies even filament-sized wronging.
branch_activations.activation: Completeness in the context meets the focus's small-scale guarantee.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The settlement's completeness extends to the smallest stated measure.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch label and facet remain attributed because no independent branch record is supplied.

branch_activations.activation: The no-withholding branch meets completeness and the minimum measure, extending fairness to each person's due share.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: No recipient's due portion is lost from the settlement.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is specifically about withholding a share; the finding does not claim that the verse describes every kind of injustice.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: çekirdek yarığındaki ya da parmak arasında bükülen ince parça; pek az şey

branch_activations.activation: The concrete fine fiber meets the completeness claim as the smallest named measure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Exact settlement reaches even a filament-sized measure.
branch_activations.boundary: The physical thread is the measure-image; the verse does not claim a literal strand is placed in the book.

findings.title: The crisis call reversed
findings.claim: The sea-crisis call toward supports that disappear, followed by turning away after rescue, meets the focus's divine summons and can expose the reference a people followed.
findings.mechanism: At 17:67, tad'una names a human-directed appeal, dalla marks the disappearance of the invoked supports, and a'radtum follows rescue. The focus repeats the call root in the opposite direction and summons every people by its imam, turning prior appeals and reversals into context for the final gathering.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees ordinary acts of calling and turning away return in the direction of judgment, where a group's orientation becomes visible.
findings.containment: The focus still describes a divine summons by each people's imam. The sea-call may be momentary crisis behavior rather than a durable allegiance, so the connection is retained as an attributed contextual reading rather than a fixed biography of each group.

epistemic.reason: The call, disappearance, and turning-away coordinates match the lean 17:67 surface and return through focus word refs, but the relation remains a legacy-unbound inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Ses ve söz, yöneltilen kişiyi ya da şeyi konuşana doğru çekmenin aracıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: At 17:67 word position 8 is tad'una; at the focus, word 2 is nad'u.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The context says the invoked supports disappear, then names turning away after rescue; the focus supplies the final call by imam.
branch_activations.activation: The same call branch spans the human appeal in danger and the divine summons at judgment, with loss and turning-away supplying the reversal.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final summons can expose the direction of earlier calls.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch gloss is supplied for the focus call; the context occurrence is retained as an attributed same-root contact.

branch_activations.carrier: At 17:67 word position 6 says the invoked supports have disappeared or become lost from the effective field.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: At word position 8 the people are calling those supports; the focus later calls every people.
branch_activations.activation: The disappearance of the appealed-to supports meets the later summons and distinguishes failed human appeal from the final call.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The direction of the final summons reverses a crisis in which other invoked supports were absent.
branch_activations.boundary: The disappearance reading remains attributed to the HFT branch; it does not claim that every invoked support is literally destroyed.

branch_activations.carrier: At 17:67 word position 15 describes turning away after rescue.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus summons each people by its imam after that reversal has been named.
branch_activations.activation: The post-rescue turning-away meets the focus's group-specific guide relation as evidence of unstable orientation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final call can disclose a group's reversal after relief.
branch_activations.boundary: The inference does not say that one crisis act establishes a permanent allegiance.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Öne konulma ve başkalarınca izlenme, insan ve insan dışı kılavuzları birleştiren çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: Imam is the followed reference attached to each people.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 17:67 sequence supplies the human call, missing supports, rescue, and turn-away.
branch_activations.activation: The crisis pattern gives the focus imam an enacted orientation context.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: A community arrives with the direction it treated as its reference.
branch_activations.boundary: The exact guide's identity and the durability of crisis behavior remain open.

findings.title: Dignity carried into accountability
findings.claim: The honor, carrying, and provision named in 17:70 meet the focus's personal book-gift, right-hand receipt, and active reading, so accountability can continue rather than erase human agency.
findings.mechanism: The preceding verbs of honoring, carrying, and providing supply a prior relation of care. In 17:71 each recipient is given a book, holds it in the right hand, and reads it; that sequence makes inspectability a continuation of dignified agency.
findings.reader_payoff: Judgment appears as an encounter in which the person can examine an assigned account, not only endure an outcome.
findings.containment: The focus still describes a favorable right-hand book and its reading. The inference is that inspectability continues the dignity of 17:70; that ayah may also function as broad framing without specifying judgment's mechanics.

epistemic.reason: The 17:70 and focus surfaces and trace positions are supplied, but the relation between prior dignity and the mechanics of judgment is an attributed inference.

findings.title: Reading under the sign of sight
findings.claim: The immediate 17:72 continuation makes 17:71's self-reading available as recognition shaped by sight and orientation already formed.
findings.mechanism: The focus recipients read their own books; the next ayah repeats blindness across present life and the hereafter, then names greater path-loss. These separate carriers meet the reading and imam in 17:71 and change the scene from neutral decoding to recognition conditioned by perception and direction.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why the book-reading follows a discussion of orientation: the encounter reveals a way of seeing already at work.
findings.containment: The focus still depicts recipients reading books. The live alternative is that 17:72 states a separate outcome rather than modifying that act; blindness is not reduced to physical eyesight, and the connection row is a nomination rather than a decision.

epistemic.reason: The exact continuation and word positions are supplied, while the connection between reading and self-recognition remains an attributed inference with a separate-ayah alternative.
